verdict.rationale: Skyfire's settlement docs set out one key liability rule. Sellers are guaranteed payment up to a valid token's committed amount and "do not carry buyer non-payment risk" (skyfire-supp-4, skyfire-docs-22, skyfire-docs-30). Charge windows and overcharge rejection are explicit (skyfire-supp-5), and in-flight tokens are honored after account deactivation (skyfire-supp-6). For card purchases, spending is capped at what the cardholder approved and identity is attached throughout (skyfire-supp-7), but no chargeback, dispute, or fraud-liability rules are documented for either flow. Missing for 10: chargeback/dispute and refund rules, fraud-liability allocation for card-based agentic purchases, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
